mapper.select: select ur.id as id, ui.user_id, ui.user_name, ui.phone, ui.avatar_url, ur.inviter_user_id, ur.invite_code, ur.create_time from user_referral ur left join user_info ui on ur.invitee_user_id = ui.user_id where ur.inviter_user_id = #{inviterUserId} order by ur.create_time desc
mapper.delete: delete from user_referral where id = #{id} and (reward_status = 'PENDING' or reward_status is null or reward_status = '')
mapper.select: select count(1) from user_referral where inviter_user_id = #{inviterUserId}

select ur.id as id, ur.invitee_user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.phone as phone, ui.avatar_url as avatar_url, ur.inviter_user_id as inviter_user_id, ui_er.user_name as inviter_user_name, ui_er.phone as inviter_phone, ur.invite_code as invite_code, ur.reward_status as reward_status, ur.reward_amount as reward_amount, ur.reward_time as reward_time, ur.create_time as create_time from user_referral ur left join user_info ui on ur.invitee_user_id = ui.user_id left join user_info ui_er on ur.inviter_user_id = ui_er.user_id where ur.inviter_user_id = #{inviterUserId} order by ur.create_time desc

select ur.id as id, ur.invitee_user_id as user_id, ui_ee.user_name as user_name, ui_ee.phone as phone, ui_ee.avatar_url as avatar_url, ur.inviter_user_id as inviter_user_id, ui_er.user_name as inviter_user_name, ui_er.phone as inviter_phone, ur.invite_code as invite_code, ur.reward_status as reward_status, ur.reward_amount as reward_amount, ur.reward_time as reward_time, ur.create_time as create_time from user_referral ur left join user_info ui_ee on ur.invitee_user_id = ui_ee.user_id left join user_info ui_er on ur.inviter_user_id = ui_er.user_id where ur.inviter_user_id in ( select first_level.invitee_user_id from user_referral first_level where first_level.inviter_user_id = #{inviterUserId} ) order by ur.create_time desc

select ur.id as id, ur.invitee_user_id as user_id, ui_ee.user_name as user_name, ui_ee.phone as phone, ui_ee.avatar_url as avatar_url, ur.inviter_user_id as inviter_user_id, ui_er.user_name as inviter_user_name, ui_er.phone as inviter_phone, ur.invite_code as invite_code, ur.reward_status as reward_status, ur.reward_amount as reward_amount, ur.reward_time as reward_time, ur.create_time as create_time from user_referral ur left join user_info ui_ee on ur.invitee_user_id = ui_ee.user_id left join user_info ui_er on ur.inviter_user_id = ui_er.user_id
and ur.inviter_user_id = #{inviterUserId}
and ur.invite_code = #{inviteCode}
and ui_ee.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
